dz: 佛罗伦萨主教祝福佛罗伦萨大教堂新钟楼（钟楼）的第一块基石，该钟楼由艺术家乔托·迪·邦多内 (Giotto di Bondone) 设计。
de: The bishop of Florence blesses the first foundation stone for the new campanile (bell tower) of the Florence Cathedral, designed by the artist Giotto di Bondone.

te: The Battle of Adramyttion begins in which a Christian naval league defeats a Turkish fleet in several encounters.
dz: 阿德拉密特通之战(Battle of Adramytion)开始,一支基督教海军联赛在数次相遇中击败了一支土耳其分舰队.
de: The Battle of Adramyttion begins in which a Christian naval league defeats a Turkish fleet in several encounters.

t: 西多会修道士红衣主教雅克·福尼埃 (Jacques Fournier) 当选教皇本笃十二世。
te: Cardinal Jacques Fournier, a Cistercian monk, is elected Pope Benedict XII.
dz: 西多会修道士红衣主教雅克·福尼埃 (Jacques Fournier) 当选教皇本笃十二世。
de: Cardinal Jacques Fournier, a Cistercian monk, is elected Pope Benedict XII.
